headline: GTCO Non-Banking Units Grow Nine-Month Pretax Profit by 70% to N23.9 Billion
summary: Guaranty Trust Holding Company's three non-banking subsidiaries recorded combined pretax profit of N23.88 billion for the nine months ended September 30, surging 70% from N14.08 billion a year earlier.
why: GTCO is one of Nigeria's largest financial services holding companies; diversification into non-banking business supports non-interest revenues.

impacts.name: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc
impacts.why: A 70% surge in non-banking earnings contributes positively to the group's consolidated profitability.
